## Acceptance

- [x] A 'Run the outage demo' control starts a seeded scenario run: the simulator gains a keyed control endpoint that starts and reports a load run (the load generator still uses only the public API), and the console's server route calls it under the same-origin and local-host rules of ADR-0012
